correctness.rationale: State definition is exact: 2^19=524288 bit assignments; open-neighbor strict majority with incumbent tie retention. Reconstructed 19×4 adjacency and 38 edges. Exhaustive integer successor maps give baseline (H,C,U,T)=(6508,2166,295138,11); edge-class (1,2) gives (3772,2670,309046,11), (1,3)=(3584,2478,310832,12), (3,9)=(3620,2490,312052,12), (3,10)=(3622,2518,311104,12). Python automorphism calculation gives four orbits of multiplicities 2,12,12,12, totaling all 38 edges; C counts cycles (half of primitive period-two state population), U counts initial states whose terminal attractor is 0 or 2^19−1. Independent full state-space vectorization reproduced all five tuples and the source C++ visits all 38 deletions. Hence exhaustive finite theorem, not sample or asymptotic impossibility claim.
